ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% high-intensity white and 40% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields on both lobes. Primary black pigmentation concentrated at the fluke-to-peduncle junction and along the trailing edges. Two distinct circular black pixel blobs are located mid-span on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 75-80 degrees and a significant bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) across the entire trailing edge; notably jagged protrusions visible on the left distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly convex curve trajectory from the distal tips sloping inward toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density white pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, low-contrast dark linear pixel paths visible within the interior white region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant calcified white masses at the far left tip. Two prominent circular dark spots on the interior field of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The black central pigmentation creates a distinct 'W' shape at the junction where the lobes meet the peduncle.
